Answer: B
Reason: The arrows in the image point to a vertical lucent stripe along the left mediastinal border, which corresponds to air collecting in the aorto-pulmonic window and outlining the inferior aspect of the aortic arch and superior border of the left pulmonary artery, a classic sign of pneumomediastinum. While subcutaneous emphysema (Option A) is also present, Option B specifically describes the mediastinal air collection indicated by the arrows that defines pneumomediastinum.
